title: Elam
lead: Elam was the kingdom of south-west Iran, with its capital at Susa, a rival of Mesopotamia for two thousand years. In the Bible it is a son of Shem (Genesis 10:22), an ally of Chedorlaomer (Genesis 14), a land of archers (Isaiah 22:6), and the subject of Jeremiah's last oracle against the nations before Babylon (Jeremiah 49:34-39). Elamites stand among the Pentecost pilgrims (Acts 2:9).
